2  THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR HEARING THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: THE HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA  -3-  NC: 2025:KHC-D:15037  MFA No. 103983 of 2016 HC-KAR  JUDGMENT (PER: THE HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA) Heard Sri M.K.Saudagar, learned counsel for the appellant.
Though notice was served upon respondents 1 and 2/claimants, they have not chosen to contest the matter.

2. Challenge in this appeal is the award that is passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-VI,
Belagavi, in MVC 451 of 2015 dated 31.08.2016.

3. Respondents 1 and 2 claiming themselves to be the wives of the deceased Ramesh Ramchandra Yadavi (hereinafter be referred to as 'the deceased' for brevity), filed a petition claiming compensation on the ground that the deceased died in a road traffic accident that occurred in the year 2014.
The tribunal through the impugned order granted a sum of Rs.6,17,000/- as compensation.
Projecting that the said sum is exorbitant, the present appeal is filed.

4. Sri M.K.Soudagar learned counsel for the appellant submits that the tribunal awarded a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
NC: 2025:KHC-D:15037 HC-KAR towards ' loss of consortium' and Rs.1,00,000/- towards 'loss of estate' which is against the law laid down and highly exorbitant.
Learned counsel thereby seeks for passing necessary orders.

5. Respondents 1 and 2/claimants are entitled to Rs.40,000/- towards 'loss of spousal consortium'
and Rs.15,000/- towards 'loss of estate'.
However, tribunal awarded a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- towards 'loss of consortium' and Rs.1,00,000/- towards 'loss of estate'.
Thus the sum awarded in excess is Rs.1,45,000/-.

Therefore, having found justification in the submission that is made by learned counsel for the appellant, the appeal is disposed of with the following:
ORDER (i) The appeal is allowed in part.

The Managing Director vs Smt.Suvarna on 4 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178316618/
3 (ii) The compensation that is granted by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal-VI,
Belagavi, through orders in MVC 451 of 2015 dated 31.08.2016 is reduced by Rs.1,45,000/-.
